test_sampler_generate_text: test the griffin_lib.Sampler class to generate text from input strings with configurable generation steps
test_sampler_output_shapes: test the Sampler output shapes for echo and return_logits options with batched inputs
test_sampler_forward_equivalence: test forward pass equivalence between direct model apply and Sampler inference for bfloat16 and float32 dtypes
test_sampler_batch_generation: test the Sampler generating text for multiple input strings in a single batch call
test_sampler_config_init: test initializing a Griffin model with recurrent and attention block types and creating a Sampler from its parameters
